scope: Profile native acceptance fixture cleanup only
cause: Warm/reload case helpers could perform UI writes and restoration, then throw before whole-case ownership version advancement.

repair.per_write_intent: Persist exact next version and intended preferred value privately before every owned-row Save; validate prior owner, organization, creation, value and version first.
repair.failure_reconciliation: Reconcile successful writes even when the action throws. Only the exact single intended successor advances ownership; the original action error remains primary.
repair.durability_failure: Keep the prior version and pending intent until confirmed progress is durably persisted; retry reconciliation on cleanup.
repair.cleanup: Owner-authenticated conditional DELETE binds the last verified intended value, exact version, owner, organization and creation timestamp. A temporary saved value is deletable only when its exact write intent was verified.
repair.unknown_outcome: A predecessor still visible after an interrupted Save is ambiguous. Refuse deletion and further Save actions while that intent remains unresolved; preserve the private receipt and report cleanup unverified. Never infer that no write is still in flight.
